summary: This filing is a routine Form 6-K submission by Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (an Argentine natural gas transmission company) containing its condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three-month period ended March 31, 2026. It includes management's discussion of financial condition and results of operations, prepared under IFRS (IAS 34) with hyperinflation adjustments per IAS 29. The filing does not disclose any merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situations transaction. It is a standard periodic financial report with no event-driven content.
